Handbook template

Default: J1C-II Research Vessel NOAH-IV. Six nodes in crew.net and six in command.net. Names, protections, functions, responses, and connections follow the printed example. Annotations are omitted.

Printed spellings UNSECURE, SECURE, and HARDENEDD are retained. EMPLOYEE1.PC is BROKEN. All TERMINAL and MOBILE TERMINAL nodes are automatic starting points. Visibility does not grant access: encrypted terminals still require keys and broken terminals remain broken.

New template starts blank with two containers. Save as copies the current template. Edits autosave into the campaign and its JSON export. Player View lists these templates as targets. Starting terminals are visible without granting access. Active targets keep their progress and snapshot; reset a target to load later template edits.
